title: Slovakian Braised Mushroom Stew
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired stew made with tender mushrooms and served with a crusty loaf of bread.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add red wine, vegetable broth, tomato paste, bay leaves, and thyme. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 20-25 minutes, or until the mushrooms are tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
